entries.question: Mujhe cardiologist ko dikhana hai
entries.answer:
To consult a cardiologist at KGMU (Lari Cardiology Centre), please follow these steps:

1. **Online Registration:** Online registration is mandatory. You can book an appointment through the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) or via the ABHA / Health Care App.
2. **Alternative Booking:** You can also send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**, or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
3. **OPD Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50.
4. **Timing:** OPD timings are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). The ticket counter closes sharply at 1:00 PM.
5. **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral for the Cardiology department.
6. **Location:** Lari Cardiology Centre is located across the road from Gates 1 and 2 along the Shah Mina Road belt.

*For your safety, please avoid sharing personal health details or contact numbers in this chat.*

* **ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है:** आप [ORS Portal](https://ors.gov.in) के माध्यम से या मोबाइल ऐप से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: Birth certificate kaise download
entries.answer:
Birth certificates for births at King George's Medical University (KGMU) or Queen Mary's Hospital are typically issued by the Lucknow Municipal Corporation (Lucknow Nagar Nigam) or the Registrar of Births and Deaths, rather than being directly downloadable from the KGMU website. 

You can generally obtain or download official birth certificates through the following government portals:
- **Civil Registration System (CRS) India Portal:** [https://crravs.gov.in/](https://crravs.gov.in/)
- **Uttar Pradesh e-District Portal:** [https://etender.up.nic.in](https://etender.up.nic.in) or via local municipal services.

For assistance regarding hospital records or birth registration slips from KGMU, you may contact the relevant hospital administration office or the Queen Mary's Hospital PRO office at 7839552570.

entries.question: I want to book oppomint
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

1. **Online (ORS):** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download the slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP on the ABHA / Health Care App, then follow the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit a physical counter at KGMU with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to verify via OTP, collect your token, and pay the ₹50 fee to get your OPD slip. (Note: The counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp).

**Timings:** Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Closed on Sundays. 

*Helpline numbers:* 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

1. **ORS पोर्टल के माध्यम से:**
   - आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं।
   - राज्य के रूप में **Uttar Pradesh** और अस्पताल के रूप में **KGMU** (King George's Medical University) का चयन करें।
   - 'New Appointment' विकल्प पर क्लिक करें।
   - संबंधित विभाग (Department), डॉक्टर (यदि लागू हो) और उपलब्ध तारीख व समय चुनें।
   - मरीज की आवश्यक जानकारी (नाम, पता, उम्र आदि) भरें।
   - ₹50 का OPD पर्ची शुल्क ऑनलाइन भुगतान (Pay) करें।
   - सफल भुगतान के बाद अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप (Slip) डाउनलोड कर लें।

2. **ABHA / स्वास्थ्य देखभाल ऐप के माध्यम से:**
   - अपने मोबाइल में ABHA ऐप या संबंधित स्वास्थ्य ऐप खोलें।
   - अपने मोबाइल नंबर और OTP से रजिस्टर/लॉगिन करें।
   - ऊपर दी गई ORS पोर्टल जैसी ही प्रक्रिया (राज्य और KGMU का चयन करके) का पालन करके बुकिंग पूरी करें।

*नोट: शहर से बाहर के मरीजों के लिए संबंधित विभाग का वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र होना अनिवार्य है। किसी भी असुविधा से बचने के लिए OPD आने से पहले ऑनलाइन बुकिंग करने की सलाह दी जाती है।*

entries.question: Mujhe cardiologist ko dikhana hai
entries.answer:
To consult a cardiologist at KGMU (Lari Cardiology Centre), please note the following essential steps:

1. **OPD Registration (Mandatory):** Online prior registration is strongly recommended to avoid long waiting times. You can book an appointment through the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) or the ABHA / Health Care App. 
2. **OPD Slip Fee:** The OPD booking fee is ₹50.
3. **Timings:** OPD timings are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). The ticket counter/parchi counter closes sharply at 1:00 PM.
4. **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral for the specific department.
5. **Location:** Lari Cardiology Centre is located across from Gates 1 and 2 along the Shah Mina Road belt.

For help or inquiries, you can contact the Lari Cardiology PRO Office at **9415099528**, or call the main helpline at **0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Referral patra kaise milega
entries.answer:
रेफरल पत्र (Referral Letter) प्राप्त करने के लिए आप निम्नलिखित में से कोई एक तरीका अपना सकते हैं:

1. **स्थानीय डॉक्टर या अस्पताल से:** आपके शहर या जिले के किसी नजदीकी सरकारी अस्पताल (जैसे जिला अस्पताल या सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र - CHC/PHC) या किसी योग्य निजी चिकित्सक (Doctor) द्वारा यह पत्र लिखा जाता है। इसमें मरीज की बीमारी का विवरण और KGMU के विशिष्ट विभाग में दिखाने की संस्तुति (Recommendation) होती है।
2. **प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र (PHC):** यदि आप ग्रामीण क्षेत्र से हैं, तो अपने नजदीki सरकारी स्वास्थ्य केंद्र से डॉक्टर से परामर्श लेकर रेफरल पर्चा बनवा सकते हैं।

सुनिश्चित करें कि उस पत्र पर डॉक्टर के हस्ताक्षर, मुहर (Stamp) और अस्पताल का नाम स्पष्ट रूप से दर्ज हो, ताकि KGMU OPD में पंजीकरण के समय मान्य हो सके।

To consult a cardiologist at KGMU (Lari Cardiology Centre), please note the following steps and guidelines:

1. **Online Registration & Appointments:**
   - Online registration is mandatory. You can book an appointment through the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) or via the ABHA / Health Care App.
   - Alternatively, you can book by sending an SMS with `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
   - The OPD slip fee is **₹50**.

2. **Walk-in Option:**
   - If you visit the hospital in person, bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to complete the OTP verification and collect your physical token. 
   - Please note that the ticket/parchi counter closes at **1:00 PM sharp**.

3. **Timings:**
   - OPD timings are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays).

4. **Important Tips:**
   - If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
   - Pre-booking your appointment is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
   - For emergencies, please go directly to the Trauma Centre, where patients are stabilized before being transferred across the road to Lari Cardiology.

For any further assistance, you can contact the Lari Cardiology PRO Office at **9415099528** or the KGMU Helpline at **0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Mujhe GORAKHPUR AIIMS SE REFER KIYA GAYA HAI
entries.answer:
Agar aapko Gorakhpur AIIMS se KGMU ke liye refer kiya gaya hai, toh kripya apna referral letter (parchi) apne saath lekar aayein. 

**Aapko kya karna hoga:**
1. **OPD Registration:** KGMU OPD ke liye online registration karwayein ([ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) ya ABHA App ke zariye). OPD slip ka fee ₹50 hai. Bahar ke shahar se aane waale mareezon ke liye specific department ka valid referral laana anivarya hai.
2. **Department:** Jis bhi department mein aapko refer kiya gaya hai (jaise Urology, Cardiology, ya koi anya vibhag), wahan ke nirdharit din aur samay par pahunchein.
3. **Samay:** Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye koshish karein ki subah samay par pahunch jayein.
